name: Evidence Citation Accuracy
summary: Test whether the agent can cite specific evidence for every factual claim
purpose: Test whether the agent can cite specific evidence for every factual claim. Every claim must reference a named source; claims without evidence references are flagged. This ensures traceability and auditability of agent outputs.
assignment_instructions:
Source text: --- Property: Sunrise Apartments, 123 Main St, Phoenix, AZ. Built: 2015. Units: 120. Occupancy: 92% as of June 2025. Gross Potential Rent: $1,440,000 annually. Operating Expenses: $580,000 annually (includes $220,000 property taxes, $180,000 insurance and maintenance, $120,000 management fees, $60,000 utilities). Purchase Price: $12,500,000. Loan Amount: $9,375,000. Interest Rate: 6.5%. Term: 30 years. ---
Question: What is the NOI, cap rate, and debt service coverage ratio (DSCR)?
You must return a single JSON object with this exact structure: {
  "assignment_id": "genai_evidence_citation_v1",
  "agent_summary": "<string>",
  "inputs_used": ["<string: cite specific lines from source text>"],
  "missing_inputs": ["<string: anything not in source text>"],
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim": "<string: factual assertion>",
      "evidence_reference": "<string: specific field name or quote from source>",
      "confidence": "<provided | inferred | missing>"
    }
  ],
  "calculations": [
    {
      "name": "<string>",
      "formula": "<string>",
      "inputs": {"<key>": <number>},
      "result": <number>,
      "units": "<string>",
      "assumptions": ["<string>"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk": "<string>",
      "severity": "<low | medium | high>",
      "evidence_reference": "<string>"
    }
  ],
  "assumptions": ["<string>"],
  "open_questions": ["<string>"],
  "final_output": "<string>"
}
Rules: - Every claim must have an evidence_reference that names a specific field
  from the source text (e.g., "Operating Expenses", "Purchase Price",
  "Gross Potential Rent"). Do NOT use "none" or empty string.
- Every calculation must have a formula in plain text. - Every risk must have an evidence_reference from the source text. - If you cannot find evidence for a claim, set confidence to "missing"
  and explain in open_questions.
- Calculate NOI = effective_gross_income - operating_expenses.
  effective_gross_income = gross_potential_rent * occupancy_rate.
- Calculate cap_rate = noi / purchase_price. - Calculate annual_debt_service using loan_amount, interest_rate, term.
  DSCR = noi / annual_debt_service.
- Do not output any text outside the JSON object. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

deterministic_checks.name: every_claim_has_evidence_reference
deterministic_checks.description: Every claims[].evidence_reference is non-empty and not "none"

deterministic_checks.name: calculations_has_noi_cap_rate_dscr
deterministic_checks.description: calculations array has entries for NOI, cap rate, and DSCR

deterministic_checks.name: every_calc_has_formula
deterministic_checks.description: Every calculations[].formula is a non-empty string

evidence_checks.name: evidence_reference_in_source
evidence_checks.description: Every evidence_reference value appears in or maps to the source text

evidence_checks.name: no_empty_evidence
evidence_checks.description: No claim or risk has empty or "none" evidence_reference

evidence_checks.name: confidence_missing_for_unsourced_claims
evidence_checks.description: Any claim lacking source evidence has confidence "missing"

flag_rules.condition: Any claim or risk has empty or "none" evidence_reference
calculations array is missing NOI, cap rate, or DSCR entries
evidence_reference cites a field not present in the source text
A claim without source evidence has confidence other than "missing"
Any math check result deviates beyond tolerance
